title: BioVarFlow parameters
description: A germline variant-calling workflow with standardized QC, annotation, and per-sample reports.

input.title: Samplesheet CSV
input.description: CSV file for variant calling input (required).

input_bam.title: BAM samplesheet (start from mapped data)
input_bam.description: CSV samplesheet with already-mapped BAM files. When provided, the pipeline skips alignment and starts from markduplicates. Required columns: patient, assay,sex, status, sample, bam, bai. Mutually exclusive with --input.

stage.title: Pipeline stage
stage.description: Which half to run. 'calling': FASTQ/BAM through Sarek to the consensus VCF, and stop - needs no panel BED, gene list, phenotypes or VEP resources. 'reporting': start from a consensus VCF plus its raw BAM and produce the annotated Excel report; requires 'Reporting input'. 'full' (default): both in one run, which is the existing behaviour.

reporting_input.title: Reporting input CSV
reporting_input.description: Required when Stage is 'reporting'. Columns: sample,raw_vcf,raw_tbi,bam,bai,assay - raw_tbi and bai default to <file>.tbi / <file>.bai, assay is optional. Hand over the RAW consensus VCF (<sample>.consensus.vcf.gz), not the filtered one: Exomiser ranks genome-wide and strand bias needs off-panel alleles, and the filtered VCF is re-derived automatically. The BAM must be the raw alignment, not a panel-filtered one.

outdir.title: Output directory
outdir.description: Where to write results (local path or gs://).

phenotypes.title: Phenotypes CSV (Exomiser)
phenotypes.description: CSV of HPO terms per sample, used by Exomiser to rank variants genome-wide. Columns: sample,sex,hpo - sex is MALE / FEMALE / UNKNOWN_SEX, hpo is a semicolon-separated list of HPO IDs (e.g. HG003,MALE,HP:0004808;HP:0002863). Exomiser is skipped for any sample not listed.

run_id.title: Run identifier
run_id.description: Identifier for this pipeline run. Written into the first column of ${outdir}/manifest/run_output_manifest.tsv. If omitted, Nextflow's auto-generated workflow.runName is used.
